column3: There seemed to be a preference of colors chosen. So for instance, purple was chosen over all the colors, than dark blue, then light blue, then pink, then orange, then yellow and then the brown color. I think we would switch turns taking the lead during the sessions, meaning one would initiate choosing a color and the other would follow with this pattern. After a bit it became faster. Keeping an eye on each other's screen also worked best as well.

we seemed to take turns being a "leader" of sorts. One person would make the first move to choose a color, and then the other person would follow. When I led, I would wait until they chose first, to make sure she saw which one I chose. When I followed, I would double check that my mouse was hovering over what she clicked. If we ever got mixed up, we'd pause for a second until someone would make the first move. We also seemed to make patterns, e.g. if a color had been picked the prior round, picking it again. This made the rounds go by quicker, without risking a mistake
